description: Prediction Market Intelligence. Four REST endpoints turning Polymarket's live public market data into agent-ready strategy/insight signal, not a raw passthrough: POST /v1/top-markets (ranked top-N currently-open markets by trailing volume), POST /v1/market-momentum (biggest observed consensus shifts), POST /v1/rotation-diff (top-100-by-30-day-volume entries/exits since a lookback, reporting insufficient_history honestly rather than fabricating a comparison), POST /v1/market-quality (0-100 liquidity/spread scoring with a reasons[] array). Every field is fetched live from Polymarket's free, public, no-key-required Gamma API at request time via a short cache; results are variable, not deterministic, since upstream data changes continuously. Every response, success or error, is a single JSON object — never HTML or plain text. Independent, standalone project: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Polymarket. Full per-endpoint parameters and behavior: see specs[] and docs.

rpc_types.backend_hint: prediction-market-intel HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Expected paths: POST /v1/top-markets, /v1/market-momentum, /v1/rotation-diff, /v1/market-quality; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. Bad input returns 4xx with a JSON error object, never HTML or plain text.

specs.notes: Covers all four endpoints in one document.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner, REST backend at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Calls Polymarket's public Gamma API on a cache miss (3-minute in-memory TTL, stale-on-error fallback), shared across suppliers' relays.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service so a wrong backend cannot be staked under this id.
Functional probe: proves the backend can reach Polymarket's Gamma API and return a correctly-shaped ranked result right now. The specific market returned is a live value and not asserted.

serving.notes: Disable local rate limiting for the RelayMiner's address. Request bodies capped at 1 MiB. Cache-miss requests make 4 parallel upstream calls (12s timeout, 1 retry) and serve stale cache rather than block. rotation-diff's snapshot history is in-memory only, resets on restart. Gateway config: type passthrough, rpc_types ["rest"]; see sage-service.yaml.
